_comment: What the admin screens would save for one category. Nothing in the code is specific to solar: change this file and the prompt, gates and scoring all follow.

project.description: 150 kW rooftop system on a warehouse in Windsor, Ontario

extraction_fields.question: Ontario electrical contractor licence number (ECRA/ESA) that the bidder itself holds. If the proposal only mentions a subcontractor's licence, leave value null.
Who holds the Ontario electrical contractor licence for this work: the bidding company, a subcontractor, or not stated?
Does the proposal state that the bidder has current WSIB clearance?
Liability insurance amount in CAD stated by the bidder (e.g. 5000000 for $5M).
Number of completed COMMERCIAL solar installations of 100 kW or more that the bidder states.
Earliest year covered by that project count (e.g. 'since 2021' -> 2021; 'in the past four years' -> current year minus 4).
Committed completion time in weeks from award. If the schedule is not committed (e.g. 'to be determined'), value is null.
Is a named / specific project lead or project manager committed? A role 'assigned later' counts as false.
Does the proposal describe the installation crew (e.g. crew size or certifications)?
Does the proposal include a site safety plan?
Does the proposal include post-installation performance monitoring of the solar system? Construction progress reports alone count as false; mention them in note.

weighted.name: Relevant experience
weighted.explain: Full marks at 10 or more commercial installs of 100 kW+ in the last 5 years; straight line down to 0.

weighted.name: Price
weighted.explain: Full marks at or below $195,000 (75% of ceiling); straight line down to 0 at the $260,000 ceiling.

weighted.name: Timeline
weighted.explain: Full marks at 10 weeks or less; straight line down to 0 at the 16-week limit.

weighted.name: Warranty
weighted.explain: Average of panel (full at 25 years) and workmanship (full at 15 years).

weighted.name: Team and approach
weighted.explain: 25 points each for: named project lead, described crew, safety plan, performance monitoring plan.
